_comment: Extra spend limit rules per gateway, beyond the pool-share rule the script
computes (wg-hpv). Empty today, and that is a finding rather than an
omission: see docs/adr/0024 and the note in ai_gateway_spend_limits.py.
A rule here is passed to the API as written, so adding one once the
dimension field names are known is a change to this file rather than to
code. Cloudflare allows 20 rules per gateway.
Every field the API expects must be present. The script does not fill any
in, because a default it invented would be a limit nobody chose.
